sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Information in this record refers to the use of water O 15 as a diagnostic agent. No information is available on the use of water O 15 during breastfeeding. United States and international authorities state that breastfeeding need not be interrupted after administration of radiopharmaceuticals containing oxygen-15.
